title: Webhook Signature Verifier
description: Verify HMAC-SHA256 webhook signatures (GitHub, Stripe-style) with SubtleCrypto — paste payload, secret and signature.
howto: Paste the exact raw request payload.
Paste the signature from the request header and pick its format.
Click Verify to get a valid/invalid verdict.

faqs.a: Raw hex, base64, "sha256=" prefixed hex (GitHub) and Stripe-style "t=…,v1=…" headers — the v1 value is extracted automatically.

faqs.q: Why does verification fail on a real payload?
faqs.a: The payload must be byte-identical to what was signed — even one changed whitespace or encoding difference breaks HMAC.
No — HMAC is computed locally with SubtleCrypto. Nothing leaves your browser.
HMAC-SHA256, which is what GitHub, Stripe and most providers sign with.
